description: This file defines a React functional component `Heatmap` that renders a calendar-style heatmap visualization for tracking habits or tasks. It includes utility functions for generating date ranges, labeling, and bucketing status data, along with JSX for rendering the grid, labels, and tooltips. It manages state for hover interactions and accepts props to customize behavior and appearance.

methods.name: dayLabelShort(date)
methods.description: Returns a short weekday label for a given date object

methods.description: Returns a short month label for a given date object

methods.name: clamp(n, min, max)
methods.description: Clamps a number between a minimum and maximum value

methods.name: getBucket(value)
methods.description: Assigns a bucket index based on a numerical value, for heatmap coloring

methods.name: buildWeeksRange({ weeks, endISO, weekStartsOn })
methods.description: Builds an array of ISO date strings representing a range of weeks ending at a specified date, aligned to start of week
